_readme: Subtitles reuse ChapterCinematicPlayer.SubtitleView and shared ChapterCinematicCue opacity; no second subtitle renderer.
Exact audioClip names bind to the existing Timeline Audio Track. audioStart/audioEnd are source-audio seconds, audioEnd -1 means the audio ends; clipIn and timeScale are respected.

Whole recordings follow their actual audio length. CLIP 10 uses three caption groups aligned to its three authored visual/audio beats: introduction, checking actions, decision. The final recording stays one complete dialogue cue. Listening/touch/device timing acceptance remains pending.
start/end are measured fallback times matching current EnvTimeline audio windows and afinfo source durations, not the retired 66-second estimate. Audio/Timeline assets are not modified.
Legacy clip/title fields and ApplyClipTimes remain for compatibility; the intro renders every line as a normal shared subtitle.

lines.text: Coast Tales. A small town by the sea.

lines.speaker: Elijah
lines.text: Coast Tales has always been a simple town.

lines.speaker: Elijah
lines.text: People work. People trade. People build their lives.

lines.speaker: Elijah
lines.text: Keeping track of it all hasn't been easy.

lines.speaker: Elijah
lines.text: And that's where I come in.

lines.speaker: Elijah
lines.text: This might be a lot, and I'm supposed to fix all this mess.

lines.speaker: Elijah
lines.text: As Coast Tales' tax consultant, every case comes across my desk.

lines.speaker: Elijah
lines.text: I read the documents. Check the numbers. Find out what's wrong.

lines.speaker: Elijah
lines.text: And decide what should be done to the case.
